spans.s: ullipta, ppp. (= Pali ullitta, chiefly in cpd. ullittāvalitta, e.g. Vin. 〔ii.117.23〕; of kūṭāgārāni, AN 〔i.101.10〕; comm. 〔ii.168.5〕 on the latter, anto ca bahi ca littāni, and similarly comm. on Vin.), in Mv 〔ii.115.11〕 kūṭāgārāṇi kārayet ulliptāvaliptāni (mss. ulliptā ca liptāni); if Pali comms. may be trusted the cpd. means smeared inside and out. (PTSD smeared up and down, evidently an etymological rendering.)
